method.input: RGB, aspect-preserving top-left resize to 640x640, black padding, /255
method.raw_postprocess: center-size boxes, score >= 0.001, top 1000 candidates per class, class-aware OpenCV NMS IoU 0.65, at most 100 per image
method.deployment: actual TensorRT engine with embedded EfficientNMS; direct inference only
method.metrics: COCO bbox AP at IoU 0.50:0.95 and 0.50; precision/recall at confidence >= 0.35 and IoU 0.50, following COCO crowd/ignore rules
method.batch_padding: last partial batch is zero-padded; padded outputs are ignored
limitations: COCO val2017 is held out from the official training recipes, but the tool cannot verify the training data of the supplied checkpoint.
OpenCV preprocessing and NMS are not proven identical to DeepStream preprocessing or the plugin.
Direct engine evaluation does not exercise the DeepStream parser, tracking or callbacks.
A small ordered subset is a smoke test, not a representative accuracy estimate.
Engine hashes are recorded; the tool cannot prove how supplied engines were built.

8.meaning: FP16 parity relative to TensorRT FP32, not an absolute accuracy guarantee
